cohort: 60 new prompts (30 COCO and 30 SDP), two independent seeds per prompt. Hash-domain color-veto-prompt-v1, seed-domain color-veto-seed-v1. Exclude all preceding color cohorts and unified 500 sources by source ID and the prior token/text matching procedure. Use the identical SD2.1-base GPU generator and 16 published WAVES edit conditions.
input: The same packed 96-bin chromaticity + 48-bin spatial rank histogram for both rules, 144 uint16 values = 288 bytes per enrolled image. Use the original two lower-tail calibration CDFs and original product cutoff.
candidate: Compute w=max(p_color,p_layout). Set v to the empirical 98th percentile of w for the original 1280 genuine edited calibration queries (inverted CDF). Permanently reject if w>v. On all 1280 calibration queries, score the vetoed items as infinity and the others by p_color*p_layout. Set the acceptance cutoff at the empirical 95th percentile. This reserves at most 2% of calibration genuine queries for veto alone. No test-dependent tuning. One candidate.
comparison: Apply each frozen cutoff to the same new 1920 edited queries. Separately choose the minimum finite product cutoff attaining at least 95% genuine acceptance on the pooled test set with each rule, preserving the candidate veto. Report actual TPR including ties or unattainability, matched-point sibling FAR and strong blur/contrast TPR with these same global cutoffs. Also report the frozen-cutoff results, paired transition counts and veto vs widened cutoff effects.
uncertainty: Paired prompt bootstrap stratified by COCO/SDP, 5000 resamples, seed 20261119. Use fixed calibration cutoffs for deployed comparisons. For descriptive pooled 95% test ROC comparisons re-estimate both product cutoffs within every resample while preserving the calibration veto. Record infeasible samples. The unit is the prompt; two directions and 16 edits remain together.
